instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\two_sided_part.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Create A-side and B-side Coordinate Systems or setups for C:\Users\User\Desktop\two_sided_part.step. Side A machines the open pocket and side B machines four counterbores. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill, T2 is a 6 mm drill, and T3 is an 8 mm end mill. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17_A.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-17_B.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
